# COFI TRADERS

> COFI TRADERS is a Costa Rican specialty coffee sourcing and export company. We connect international roasters and importers with traceable micro-lots from small producers in the Brunca region of Costa Rica, including Coto Brus and Pérez Zeledón.

## What we do

COFI TRADERS sources specialty coffee micro-lots directly from small farmers in Costa Rica's Brunca region and exports them to roasters in Europe, the United States, Japan, and Korea. We provide full traceability from farm to roaster, Q-grader cupping data, and direct producer relationships.

We are not a large exporter or a cooperative. We are a small, curated operation — the direct bridge between the farmer and the international roaster.

## Our producers

**Lica Torres — Cerro Buena Vista Micro-Beneficio**
- Location: Rivas, Pérez Zeledón, Brunca region, Costa Rica
- Processes: White Honey, Black Cherry (anaerobic)
- Altitude: 1,600–1,800 masl
- Varieties: SL28, H10

**Don Humberto — El Arrempujón Micro-Beneficio**
- Location: Sabalito, Coto Brus, Brunca region, Costa Rica
- Processes: Honey, Natural
- Altitude: 1,300 masl
- Varieties: Venecia, Centroamericano

## Current lots (2025 harvest)

**Etíope 47 — White Honey**
- Variety: SL28
- Process: White Honey
- Altitude: 1,800 masl
- Producer: Lica Torres, Cerro Buena Vista
- Region: Brunca, Pérez Zeledón, Costa Rica
- Flavor notes: Jasmine, violet, lemon, mandarin, peach, granadilla, caramel, tapa de dulce
- URL: https://cofi.cr/lotes/etiope-white-honey

**Milenio H10 — Black Cherry**
- Variety: H10
- Process: Black Cherry (anaerobic)
- Altitude: 1,600 masl
- Producer: Lica Torres, Cerro Buena Vista
- Region: Brunca, Pérez Zeledón, Costa Rica
- Flavor notes: Plum, raisin, fig, port wine, blackberry, cacao nibs. Winey, creamy finish.
- URL: https://cofi.cr/lotes/black-cherry

**Milenio H10 — Red Honey**
- Variety: H10
- Process: Red Honey
- Altitude: 1,600 masl
- Producer: Lica Torres, Cerro Buena Vista
- Region: Brunca, Pérez Zeledón, Costa Rica
- Flavor notes: Red fruits, honey, plum. Sweet, balanced, silky body.

**Venecia — Honey**
- Variety: Venecia
- Process: Honey
- Altitude: 1,300 masl
- Producer: Don Humberto, El Arrempujón
- Region: Sabalito, Coto Brus, Brunca, Costa Rica
- Flavor notes: Mandarin, peach, caramel, cacao, sugarcane honey. Juicy and silky mouthfeel.
- URL: https://cofi.cr/lotes/venecia-honey

**Centroamericano — Natural**
- Variety: Centroamericano
- Process: Natural
- Altitude: 1,300 masl
- Producer: Don Humberto, El Arrempujón
- Region: Sabalito, Coto Brus, Brunca, Costa Rica
- Flavor notes: Red fruits, plum, red wine, sugarcane honey, cacao. Juicy, creamy, long finish.
- URL: https://cofi.cr/lotes/centroamericano

## Why COFI TRADERS

- **Direct access**: Founded by someone who grew up in Sabalito, Coto Brus — the same community where the producers live. Not an external intermediary.
- **Full traceability**: Every lot is documented with producer profile, farm photos, GPS coordinates, and Q-grader cupping data.
- **Q-grader verified**: All lots are cupped by a certified Q-grader before export.
- **Small and curated**: We work with a select group of producers each season to guarantee consistency and quality.
- **International logistics**: We handle export documentation, sample shipping, and green coffee logistics to Europe, USA, Japan, and Korea.
